signOutHint: Scheduled work keeps running on your account; to stop it, remove the program's access on the account site.
assistantsIntro: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other assistants that speak MCP can read your projects' SEO data and answer questions about it. Before buying data they tell you the price and wait for your yes; your monthly budgets apply.
desktopHowTo: Add this to your assistant's MCP settings. The assistant starts this program with mcp, without a window, on the same data folder; it works while the window is open too.
copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it.
tokensHint: A token lets an assistant use your account. Make one per assistant and revoke it when you stop using it (at most 10).
revokeConfirm: Revoke the token "{name}"? Assistants using it stop working.
tokenOnce: The token "{name}" is in the settings below. Copy it now: it is shown only this once.
